text:
maria: Heads-up: we're entering a 36hr release freeze starting Fri 09:00 UTC. This affects any change to the serving stack, scheduler, model registry, or infra config that could impact latency or correctness. Read the exception flow below.

jordan: Got it. Does this include Dedicated clusters?

maria: Yes — freeze is global for infra and runtime. Non-runtime app changes (docs, non-blocking UI text) can go if they're small and flagged canary=false.

li: We have an embed model rollback ready. Can we roll back during freeze?

maria: Rollbacks are allowed but must use the exception process (quick approval). We prefer rollbacks to untested forward fixes.

sanjay: Quick exception checklist?

maria: Exception flow: please follow exactly:

1) Open a PR with the rollback/hotfix and link tests.
2) Fill the exception form: https://rdrw.in/release-exceptions (choose "hotfix" or "rollback").
3) Ping @release-lead + @sre in this channel with a short risk summary.
4) Ops will schedule a manual deploy if approved. Aim for <2 hours approval for critical incidents.

release-lead: Adding: include rollback command and owner in the form, and a clear monitoring/abort plan.

deploy-bot: Canary window scheduled: Mon 2026-06-15 13:30-14:30 UTC for embed-service-v2 on dedicated-us-west. Reporter: @li.

li: Thanks — I'll attach the smoke test grafana link after run.

jordan: Are we limiting canaries during the freeze?

maria: Yes. Low-risk canaries allowed if no kernel changes, no quantization toggles, and they pass a 30-min SLO gate (latency & error budget). If latency >5% or errors spike, abort immediately and notify #incidents.

sanjay: Ops note: autoscaler cooldown changes are disruptive — schedule them after embargo unless urgent.

maria: Changelog highlights for this train:
- runtime: memory leak mitigation in KV cache (canary).
- autoscaler: adjust cooldown to reduce flapping at low QPS.
- embeddings: fix tokenization failure on long inputs.
- console: rollout page shows per-model tail-latency now.

maria: TL;DR: freeze Fri 09:00 UTC for 36hr; follow exception form + ping @release-lead; canaries allowed but gated. Ping me or @release-lead if you need an expedited review. :warning:
